sources.title: OpenHistoricalMap historical boundary relations
sources.coverage: Community historical boundary relations; CC0/public-domain except elements carrying an explicit alternative open license
sources.notes: Production use requires the exact relation id/version, confirmation that no element-specific license overrides CC0, a pinned project archive blob, distributed spatial controls, and independent A1/A2/A3 historical evidence. OHM relations are never authoritative by themselves.
